objectives.name: Premier Pride
objectives.text: Win 2 matches while having Min. 3 Premier League players in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit Professional Event.

objectives.name: French Connection
objectives.text: Score at least 3 goals in one match while having Min. 1 French player in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit Professional Event.

objectives.name: Belgian Tower
objectives.text: Assist at least 3 goals while having Min. 1 Belgian player in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit Professional Event.

objectives.name: Three Lions Legacy
objectives.text: Score at least 1 goal in 2 separate matches while having Min. 1 English player in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit Professional Event.

objectives.name: Win 1
objectives.text: Win 1 match in the FC Heritage Circuit Professional Event and qualify for the FC Heritage Circuit World Class Event.

events.title: FC Heritage Circuit World Class Event

objectives.name: Bundesliga Backbone
objectives.text: Win 3 matches while having Min. 3 player items from Bundesliga in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit World Class Event

objectives.name: Bavarian Thunder
objectives.text: Score 5 goals while having Min. 1 FC Bayern München (Bundesliga) player item in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit World Class Event

objectives.name: Paris Power Surge
objectives.text: Assist 4 goals while having Min. 1 PSG (Ligue 1) player item in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit World Class Event

objectives.name: Bernabéu Thunder
objectives.text: Score at least 1 goal in 3 separate matches while having Min. 1 Real Madrid (LALIGA) player item in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit World Class Event

objectives.name: Thunder Final
objectives.text: Win the FC Heritage Circuit Tournament while having Min. 2 Premier League players in your starting 11.

objectives.name: Ligue 1 Finest
objectives.text: Win 2 matches while having Min. 2 Ligue 1 players in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit Tournament.

objectives.name: Oranje Legacy
objectives.text: Assist at least 1 goal in 3 separate matches while having Min. 1 Dutch player in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit Tournament.

objectives.name: Madrid Royalty
objectives.text: Score at least 1 goal in 3 separate matches while having Min. 1 Real Madrid (LALIGA) player in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit Tournament.

objectives.name: French Thrill
objectives.text: Score at least 2 goals in 1 match while having Min. 1 French player in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit Tournament.

objectives.name: Serie A after Dark
objectives.text: Win 1 Quarter-Finals match while having Min. 2 Serie A players in your starting 11 in the FC Heritage Circuit Tournament.
